messages.message: Hi, mera bill bahut zyada aaya hai, please check karo! 😡
Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I am Daniel. How can I help you today?
Yaar, my bill is 5000 rupees, it should be 1500. Yeh kya ho raha hai? I am so frustrated!
I am sorry to hear that you are feeling frustrated, Aisha Johnson. I can definitely look into this for you.
Haan, please check. My number is 97817 86860 and I live at 138 Brigade Road.
Thank you. I see a double charge for the international roaming pack. It looks like a mistake on our end.
Exactly! Maine toh sirf ek pack buy kiya tha. Please fix it fast.
I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Please note that the refund is subject to approval and usually takes 7-10 business days to reflect in your account.
Theek hai, that is fine. Thank you for the quick help, Daniel!
You are very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I have raised the request, and you will get an email confirmation. Goodbye!
